question:
**Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.**

We will always rember your contribusion.

options.text: We will always remembar your contributoin.
We will always remember your contribution.
We will always remmember your contrabution.
We will always remembber your contribution.

solution:
The correct answer is "**We will always remember your contribution**".
